_comment: Applied by the paperless-workflows-apply Job (ingestbuddy#7 / infra-ops#61 + #56). This is NOT the raw Paperless /api/workflows/ payload shape: filter_has_all_tag_names / filter_has_not_tag_names are resolved to real tag IDs by apply.py (name -> ID, after pipeline-tags.json has been upserted) before the real API call is made. The webhook header's __PAPERLESS_WEBHOOK_SECRET__ placeholder is substituted with the live INGESTBUDDY_PAPERLESS_WEBHOOK_SECRET value from this Job's environment (ExternalSecret external-paperless-workflows-credentials) -- never commit the real secret value here. This file is consumed via a kustomize configMapGenerator (see ../kustomization.yaml), so any edit here changes the generated ConfigMap's content-hash suffix, which changes the Job's pod template, which is what makes ArgoCD's Replace=true,Force=true actually recreate and re-run the Job -- editing this file is itself the 'force a rerun' mechanism, nothing else to bump. The workflow 'name' below is deliberately still 'pipeline:eingang intake' even though the gate tags were renamed to ingestbuddy:* (ingestbuddy#9): apply.py upserts the workflow by exact name match, so renaming it here would POST a second workflow instead of updating live workflow id 4. Rename it only in lockstep with an in-place API rename of workflow 4. The body carries doc_id only: ingestbuddy's receiver reads nothing else (its other fields default to empty), and Paperless substitutes placeholders without JSON escaping, so a quote or backslash in a title or correspondent used to make the body invalid JSON (400, the document then waited for the 15-minute reconciliation).
name: pipeline:eingang intake
